notes.title: Law School - Episode 1 Available now for Early Access Supporters
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I hope you are all doing well! 

Today is a special day for me, and I know this announcement can confuse some people or make them a bit lost. So, I want to be fully sincere and address right away why I am mentioning this here on Steam regarding a release I am doing on my Patreon page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/30dbded83bf4636cc76366f03614debf9f874a8c.png[/img]

[h3]Why Patreon? What about Steam?[/h3]

Some may not know, but [b]The Entrepreneur[/b] started as an early access project on Patreon, and once it evolved into a complete game, it was released on Steam. [i](This practice is common, if not standard, for 3D Adult Visual novel developers)[/i]

[b]It will be the same approach for Law School! [/b]Today marks the official release of Law School's first episode, which will be available for those who like to play/preview things very early through my Patreon page.

[b]Once Law School - Chapter 1  Development is 100% complete, I will release it on Steam immediately![/b]

I hope this makes things a bit cleaner right away. I sincerely appreciate the understanding and support both communities have given me so far; I can't express how fantastic everyone in the MisterMaya community is! :hearts: 

Now, I want to talk a bit more about Law School for those who are unfamiliar with this project:

[h2]Introducing “Law School”[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/b1ef708ff0e467050566056c1e5cb627ed160777.png[/img]
Embark on an exhilarating journey in “Law School” to become America's most renowned lawyer. At
18, fresh out of high school, you and your best friend Rose head to Stocklinburg University. This
prestigious institution is your gateway to mastering the legal landscape and realizing your dream.
Prepare for the challenges and vibrant experiences of a freshman in college.

[h2]Diverse and Engaging Cast[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/56c1a511b00e7e577db391635c508aba3f8a63f6.gif[/img]
“Law School” features six unique love interests, each crafted with meticulous attention to detail. My
characters boast distinct personalities and rich backstories, ensuring no two are alike. You'll find
yourself immersed in their development and narratives. In addition, a dynamic ensemble of secondary
characters - friends, adversaries, casual “acquaintances” (wink-wink), classmates, and staff - enrich
your daily college life, each contributing their own intriguing stories.

[h2]Immersive Gameplay[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/c6edf59f68aeefa407f9113abd7bfb605474e4bd.png[/img]
The gameplay in “Law School” goes beyond standard relationship management and story-affecting
decisions. Enjoy mini-games, optional free-roam events in each episode, and access to “Facegram,”
the game's integrated social media platform. Music selection is tailored to each scene, enhancing the
atmosphere.

[h2]To Summarize?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/f90df21aa486651e04143f941b8c2af881b42c3a.png[/img]
Law School is a MUCH BIGGER GAME than The Entrepreneur in which you'll experience the same
thrilling sensations, if not more. More sex, decisions, humor, and a new game system. All
together, they result in another dream, another cast of sexy girls, and another adventure all waiting for you.

Here is a comparison between the entire The Entrepreneur against Law School Episode 1

[u]The Entrepreneur[/u]

5200 images
160 animations
+230 songs
160 scenes

[u]Law School - Episode 1 
[/u]
3000 images 
71 animations
82 Songs
43 scenes + 1 Freeroam + Access to Facegram

[b]Thank you for your support,

notes.title: Law School: Episode 1 Development Update #2
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Law School Enthusiasts![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/41c1ab352e98c33fd5caf4313fb1876df664d01a.png[/img]
I am thrilled to share with you the second update for "Law School: Journey to Becoming America's
Top Lawyer." Your warm reception of my demo has been incredibly heartening. Your positive
feedback and constructive criticism have been invaluable, and I assure you, every piece of advice and
concern is being considered to deliver an outstanding first episode.

[h2]Progress Recap for Last Month[/h2]
[previewyoutube=H_1rwePUS3k;full][/previewyoutube]
It's been a relatively slow month in the development of Law School, mainly due to the demo's release a
fortnight ago. Designing a unique and personalized game GUI from scratch was a hefty but rewarding
task. While the core coding of the game is established, allowing for easy tweaks and adjustments, there
may still be further enhancements as we approach the first episode's release.But I'm glad that Law
School will have a unique design, on which I work hard.

[h2]Improvement in the workflow[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/506760ddca99118074d67c6f60baa798af9e9871.png[/img]
I previously mentioned a bottleneck in my rendering process due to an overwhelming amount of
animations and statics. My second computer struggled with the load of over 300 statics and 2
animations, both of them totaling more than 200 frames; in the rendering queue.
However, upgrading to an RTX 4090 GPU has significantly expedited the process, reducing the queue
to just 40 statics.
This upgrade not only speeds up rendering but also enables me to add more animations, enhancing the
game's transition effects, a feature I'm particularly excited about.

[h2]Where do we stand now?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/2fac21c45b9cd404e25bfdd687da7ca156a97ead.png[/img]
As of now, Law School boasts approximately 1900 statics and 31 animations, with over half of the
content complete. I'm confident that we are on track for a March 2024 release, anticipating around
3000 statics and 60 animations to create a well-rounded first episode.

[h2]Goals for the upcoming month[/h2]
[previewyoutube=UKM0HZFBUcE;full][/previewyoutube]
The primary focus for the next month is to complete the remaining 1000 statics and additional
animations by January's end. This will allow February to be dedicated to post-production tasks such as
editing, coding, music composition, and testing, gearing up for the March release.
Ensuring thorough testing by our dedicated testers is crucial to avoid the pitfalls experienced with
previous releases of "The Entrepreneur."
Our goal is to launch a flawless first episode for Law School.

[h2]Final Thoughts[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/5e4389a2630cb6e39b6580d935b97537f3a1d72b.png[/img]
This month has been a rewarding journey, filled with a blend of excitement and anxiety. Seeing the
game take shape and receiving such positive community feedback is both affirming and motivating. I
eagerly await the moment when you can experience the game in its full glory. I hope it brings you as
much joy as it has brought me in its creation.

Now, back to the grind – another day, another scene!

Warm regards,

MisterMaya
